<span id="a863c9ce"></span>
# Feature Overview

Visual knowledge processing has the ability of external output, which supports the return of the offline database & table generated by the system to its own native system for secondary data production and mining. The processed data is output to the data storage outside the system through visual knowledge processing, so as to realize the output capacity construction of data assets. Whether to allow the output can be consulted by the owner of the data connection. If the system supports the output, the switch can be turned on in the data connection configuration. This article will show you how to use external output operators.

Currently supported external storage: Maxcompute, OceanBase Oracle/MySQL/BytehouseCE.

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div>



1. <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">This function is a <strong>paid</strong> function, please contact your business manager if you need it.</div>


2. <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">Visual knowledge processing external output (paid function): Data input and content production logic are free and flexible, supporting visual completion of data processing by dragging and dropping, and supporting the return of production and processing data to offline warehouses to achieve more flexible data output and application.</div>



<span id="9e68680e"></span>
# Usage Restrictions

Users need to have **project center \- permissions \- by content management \- modules \- data access \- visual knowledge processing \- new task** permissions.

<span id="bfc79756"></span>
# Operation Steps

**Operation flow chart**

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

**Currently supported external storage**


|**data source** |**supported version** |**environment** |
|---|---|---|
|MaxCompute |1.20.2 |Private & SaaS |
|OceanBase Oracle / Mysql |1.20.2 |private department |
|Oracle |1.20.2 |private department |
|BytehouseCE |1.22.2 |Private & SaaS |
|MySQL |1.20.2 |private department |


**The specific operation steps are as follows:** 


1. In the left navigation bar of Enterprise Knowledge Engine, select **Data Access** \> **Knowledge Access**.

2. Click the **New Data Connection** button in the upper left corner of the data connection directory, take MaxCompute as an example, and select **MaxCompute** data connection.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/fbf1a0cc06dc428aaca488a56cd8a560~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

3. On the edit page, fill in the corresponding server and key information, the permission mode opens the **write** permission, and after the test connection is successful, click **Save**.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c4995e0890b64823a6d9726dfa31ee26~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

4. In the left navigation bar of Enterprise Knowledge Engine, select **Data Access** \> **Visual Knowledge Processing** and create a new task on the **Task List** page.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5b4afbf7b6a64d438bc5227c861388bd~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

5. On the task editing page, you can freely perform data cleaning and processing. After completion, add **external output** operators.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4cff600095334c998ba157172e25afc9~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

6. Select Create a good data connection and fill in the **database & table information** .


**Output to system external storage.** 

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e8f2b299835847cd9fa2f8dbcd62cbd8~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

Create a new output table with the following parameters:


* Data connection: Select a target data source that supports data writing.

* Database: Select the target database under Data Sources.

* Table name: Set the target table name for data output. If the table does not exist, the system will automatically create it based on upstream field information.


**Dependency configuration**

Configure the data dependencies of tasks, and support configuring upstream dependencies and self\-dependencies


* **Upstream dependencies** support system auto\-configuration and custom configuration.

   * The automatic configuration of the system will automatically generate upstream data dependencies, and you can decide whether to use them according to the actual situation.

   * When selecting a custom configuration, you can manually add data dependencies.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/32e8841623db4fc1938d72cd3960be49~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

      After entering the new dependency interface, you can search for the corresponding task or dataset to create a dependency, and the corresponding dependency will be generated after selecting the corresponding task. If you need to create a system custom dependency manually, you can contact technical support for assistance.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/713788075f2f43f7be47bffb5fc42320~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* **Self\-dependency:** 

   * When the switch is turned on, the current task is dependent on the operation of the task in the past, and supports setting the earliest data backtracking time configuration. If the task of the previous cycle fails, the task of the next cycle cannot be run.

   * When the switch is turned off, the current task does not depend on the operation of the task in the past, and even if the task of the previous cycle fails, the task of the next cycle can be run normally.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/df00e34df3194c1ab4dfc5a8d9ae01d2~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


**Advanced Configuration**

Further configuration of advanced parameters for the operator to perform tasks is supported.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/cf282df33871477f8dee775a9b56ef46~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

**Monitoring configuration**

Support setting multiple alarm rules, each alarm rule is set up to 5 alarm conditions, or the logical relationship between the rules, that is, to meet any one will trigger a notification, support the user according to the drop\-down box selection result **abnormal alarm, failure alarm, timeout alarm** 3 types.

When the task execution meets the alarm conditions, it supports notifying the designated user through Lark, DingTalk, etc.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/66914735ab144447af10fc49f170b227~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>
